exposure: significant risk factors for ectopic pregnancy
symptoms at presentation of abortion request
Routine ultrasound use in abortion services
outcome: Utility of routine ultrasound in detecting ectopic pregnancy
cohort: Women requesting abortion over a 5-year period (2015-2019) at a community abortion service in Edinburgh, UK
finding: Ectopic pregnancies are uncommon among women presenting for abortion, and the value of routine ultrasound in excluding ectopic pregnancy in symptom-free women without significant risk factors is questionable.
